neighbours.label: Weak. Tokens inside the names and slogans of political movements and organised labour ('trade union', 'Non-Aligned Movement', 'the socialist path', 'banner of peace'); quiet on the same words in non-political use.
fire: Dockworkers voted to strike after the trade union leaders rejected the offer.
Several newly independent states joined the Non-Aligned Movement in 1961.
Egypt under Nasser chose the socialist road of development.
The general strike was called by the national federation of trade unions.
Delegates at the congress of the Workers' Party adopted a new programme.
The liberation front won most seats in the first national elections.
Marchers carried red banners of the labour movement through the square.
The party pledged solidarity with anti-colonial movements across Africa.
quiet: Dockworkers unloaded the ship after the crane was finally repaired.
Several newly built hotels opened along the beach in 1961.
Egypt under clear skies is a lovely place to sail the Nile.
The general store was run by the same family for decades.
Delegates at the dental congress tried a new brand of toothpaste.
The front garden won a prize in the village flower show.
Marchers carried bright balloons through the square on New Year's Day.
The party ended late, and everyone helped clean the kitchen.
